subject: Clarify tenant attribution for GCP July usage and VAT tagging
messages:
From: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@atlascloud.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: billing@atlascloud.io
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 13:07:00 -0700
Subject: Question on tenant-level attribution for July GCP invoice

Rafael —

Quick one from our side after we received the July marketplace statement. We see a single consolidated charge that includes three distinct tenant IDs (T-331, T-332, T-333) but the line-item export you provided earlier doesn't map those tenant IDs to customer IDs in our onboarding sheet. Finance is asking for: 1) tenant-to-customer mapping for all July line items, 2) confirmation of which tenant paid VAT in which jurisdiction, and 3) any invoice-level credits applied during claim reconciliation.

I attached the raw GCP line export and our preferred tenant mapping template. Can your team confirm the mapping and supply VAT evidence (if any) so we can close the month? We have a procurement cut-off next Friday.

Thanks —
Amelia Carter
AtlasCloud, Billing Ops
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@atlascloud.io>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on tenant-level attribution for July GCP invoice

Amelia —

Thanks for the heads up and the export. We're looking into it. Preliminary notes:
- The consolidated charge shows usage from two serving pools that were routed under a single marketplace SKU for July after a transient reroute on 7/17. That change created multi-tenant lines in the consolidated CSV.
- We maintain an internal tenant mapping table (attached) but I agree we should provide a cleaned mapping in your template.
- VAT: for two tenants we have EU VAT flagged as pass-through; the third tenant was billed in the UK and we have a VAT-withholding tag on that line. We'll need to confirm invoicing evidence.

I'm looping in Irene (Platform Finance) and Marissa (Marketplace ops) to stitch together the proof package and confirm any credits/adjustments. Expect a follow-up by end of day tomorrow with a mapping and a short reconciliation note.

Best,
Rafael
Head of Marketplace Billing, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@atlascloud.io>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on tenant-level attribution for July GCP invoice

All —

Quick status update and ask from Finance: we pulled the serving-route audit and the billing engine trace for the July window. Action items we completed and outstanding:

Completed:
- Exported raw line items (GCP_line_items_202607.csv) and attached our tenant mapping (tenant_mapping_202607.xlsx). Mapping column 'marketplace_account_id' -> 'atlas_tenant_id' filled where matched.
- Identified a reroute event on 2026-07-17 between pool-a and pool-b; this produced merged SKU lines for a two-day window.

Outstanding / Need from AtlasCloud:
1) Please confirm customer IDs for Atlas tenant T-332 — our mapping matched T-331 and T-333 but T-332 has no onboarding match. If T-332 is a reseller or nested entity we need the higher-level payer.
2) VAT evidence: for any tenant you claim VAT was remitted locally, please send either an invoice showing VAT charged or a tax remittance receipt. A consolidated note from your tax team is acceptable.
3) Confirm whether any procurement credits (PO-level discounts) were applied on your side in July; we will mirror any credits in our refund ledger if present.

We'll assemble a short reconciliation memo once #1-3 are confirmed. Target for memo: 2026-09-24 COB.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Platform Finance, Redwood Inference
From: AtlasCloud Billing <billing@atlascloud.io>
To: rafael.mendes@redwood.com
Cc: Amelia Carter <amelia.carter@atlascloud.io>, finance@acme-corp.com
Date: Fri, 24 Sep 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on tenant-level attribution for July GCP invoice

Rafael / Irene / Marissa —

Attached: VAT_evidence_bundle.pdf (redacted receipts), tenant_mapping_filled.xlsx (filled per your template), short_note_recons.pdf. Summary:
- T-331 -> AtlasCustomer-ACME (payer on file)
- T-332 -> AtlasReseller-RubyCloud (reseller billing; higher-level payer: AtlasCustomer-RubyHoldings)
- T-333 -> AtlasCustomer-ForgeCo (payer on file)

VAT notes: T-333 (UK) charged VAT at point of sale — receipt included. T-331 and T-332 were EU intra-community supplies: VAT reverse-charge applied; we included a tax team note for each transaction.

Procurement credits: there was a one-time marketplace promo credit applied on 2026-07-18 to T-331 (promo-REFUND-07-18) — we included a credit ledger export in the bundle. Please confirm you can mirror that credit against your July ledger.

Happy to hop on a 30m call Monday if you want to walk through the attachments.

Regards,
AtlasCloud Billing Ops

Attachments: VAT_evidence_bundle.pdf (3 pages, redacted), tenant_mapping_filled.xlsx (1 sheet), short_note_recons.pdf (2 pages)
